blocks.text: False news peddlers are back with the same antics but new lies on social media
MANILA, Philippines – Fabricated, altered, or AI-generated.
These are the tactics of false news peddlers this September, sharing lies on social media. The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte has been at the center of it all since July 2026.
Watch this video by researcher-writer Lourence Marcellana to separate truth from fiction. – Rappler.com
